# P07 · Voice: speech service and child voices — tasks

**Goal (3 lines):** The Practice Class works by voice (hold to speak) in Hindi, Tamil and English with five distinct child voices, falling back to text automatically.
Pipeline: audio → speech-to-text → the text pipeline → child line → speech synthesis in parallel with call 7 → audio released only on pass; per-stage latency in the `layers` trace.
Everything is built and tested without the network; live measurement waits on a working Sarvam key.

**Read:** BUILD_PROMPTS P07; design §AI layer (Speech layer), §Practice Class (Child voices), §Server-side fallbacks; CLAUDE.md §8.

**Starting commit:** `874d069` · **Started:** 2026-10-17

## Tasks

- [ ] **T01 · Verify Sarvam facts, record in DECISIONS; speech pricing** — done when DECISIONS holds the facts with links and `services/speech/pricing.yaml` has source and date.
- [ ] **T02 · Speech clients** — `sarvam.py` (HTTP, errors mapped, bounded retries), `stt.py` (ffmpeg to 16 kHz wav, chunks ≤ 28 s at silences), `tts.py` (cache by hash, mp3 → ffmpeg OGG/Opus mono), `voices.py` (persona → stock speaker + pitch ratio, clone behind a flag), `health.py` (circuit breaker). Tests with respx and real ffmpeg: chunking never exceeds the limit, cache hit, pitch changes with duration kept, breaker opens after 3 failures.
- [ ] **T03 · Stub speech** — `SPEECH_MODE=stub`: scripted transcripts and a generated tone, for tests and demos.
- [ ] **T04 · Voice turn in the API** — `POST …/voice-turn`; TTS in parallel with call 7; audio only on pass; stage timings into `layers`; 503 with a text-mode flag on failure.
- [ ] **T05 · Client** — hold-to-speak, listening/thinking/speaking states, automatic text after 2 failures or 2g, manual switch. Playwright with fake microphone and stub speech.
- [ ] **T06 · Pronunciation notes and dictionary wiring** — `content/pronunciation/{hi,ta}.yaml`, `dict_id` from env.
- [ ] **T07 · Live measurement scripts** — `scripts/voice_latency.py`, `scripts/check_voices.py` (ready; run when the key works).
- [ ] **T08 · Docs `docs/speech.md`, i18n, reviews, report.**
